info.name:
Creates a model response. Provide [text](/docs/guides/text) or
[image](/docs/guides/images) inputs to generate [text](/docs/guides/text)
or [JSON](/docs/guides/structured-outputs) outputs. Have the model call
your own [custom code](/docs/guides/function-calling) or use built-in
[tools](/docs/guides/tools) like [web search](/docs/guides/tools-web-search)
or [file search](/docs/guides/tools-file-search) to use your own data
as input for the model's response.

info.name: Retrieves a model response with the given ID.

params.name: response_id
params.description: The ID of the response to retrieve.

params.name: include
params.description:
Additional fields to include in the response. See the `include`
parameter for Response creation above for more information.

params.name: stream
params.description:
If set to true, the model response data will be streamed to the client
as it is generated using [server-sent events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events#Event_stream_format).
See the [Streaming section below](/docs/api-reference/responses-streaming)
for more information.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The sequence number of the event after which to start streaming.

params.name: include_obfuscation
params.description:
When true, stream obfuscation will be enabled. Stream obfuscation adds
random characters to an `obfuscation` field on streaming delta events
to normalize payload sizes as a mitigation to certain side-channel
attacks. These obfuscation fields are included by default, but add a
small amount of overhead to the data stream. You can set
`include_obfuscation` to false to optimize for bandwidth if you trust
the network links between your application and the OpenAI API.

info.name: Returns a list of input items for a given response.

params.name: response_id
params.description: The ID of the response to retrieve input items for.

params.name: limit
params.description:
A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between
1 and 100, and the default is 20.

params.name: order
params.description:
The order to return the input items in. Default is `desc`.
- `asc`: Return the input items in ascending order.
- `desc`: Return the input items in descending order.

params.name: after
params.description: An item ID to list items after, used in pagination.

params.name: include
params.description:
Additional fields to include in the response. See the `include`
parameter for Response creation above for more information.

info.name:
Compact a conversation. Returns a compacted response object.

Learn when and how to compact long-running conversations in the [conversation state guide](/docs/guides/conversation-state#managing-the-context-window). For ZDR-compatible compaction details, see [Compaction (advanced)](/docs/guides/conversation-state#compaction-advanced).
